route_text: {"target_smiles":"C[C@@H]1CC[C@@H](C)N1CCCOc1ccc(-c2ccc(C(=O)N3CCOCC3)cc2)cc1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线以高效且高收敛性为设计原则。逆合成分析首先断开叔胺与丙基碳链之间的碳氮键，将目标分子简化为手性反式-2,5-二甲基四氢吡咯与溴丙氧基联苯酰胺中间体。这一后期N-烷基化策略避免了碱性极性较强的叔胺片段在前序反应中对催化剂产生不利配位。亲电试剂中间体则通过酚羟基的Williamson醚化反应引入3-溴丙基，其底物为4-(4-羟基苯基)苯甲酰吗啉。该中间体可进一步经酰胺键切断，由4-(4-羟基苯基)苯甲酸与吗啉经缩合剂活化后选择性反应制得。最后，联苯骨架由市售易得的4-羟基苯基硼酸和4-溴苯甲酸通过Suzuki-Miyaura交叉偶联构建。全路线仅需4步，反应条件温和，步骤高度收敛，原料均为商业级基础化学品。","key_disconnection_class":"N-alkylation","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":4,"strategy":"联苯骨架组装与后期胺烷基化","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"C[C@@H]1CC[C@@H](C)N1CCCOc1ccc(-c2ccc(C(=O)N3CCOCC3)cc2)cc1","precursors":["O=C(c1ccc(-c2ccc(OCCCBr)cc2)cc1)N1CCOCC1","C[C@@H]1CC[C@@H](C)N1"],"reaction_class":"N-alkylation"},{"step_id":2,"product":"O=C(c1ccc(-c2ccc(OCCCBr)cc2)cc1)N1CCOCC1","precursors":["O=C(c1ccc(-c2ccc(O)cc2)cc1)N1CCOCC1","BrCCCBr"],"reaction_class":"Williamson ether synthesis"},{"step_id":3,"product":"O=C(c1ccc(-c2ccc(O)cc2)cc1)N1CCOCC1","precursors":["O=C(O)c1ccc(-c2ccc(O)cc2)cc1","C1COCCN1"],"reaction_class":"amide coupling"},{"step_id":4,"product":"O=C(O)c1ccc(-c2ccc(O)cc2)cc1","precursors":["OB(O)c1ccc(O)cc1","O=C(O)c1ccc(Br)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki-Miyaura coupling"}],"starting_materials":["BrCCCBr","C1COCCN1","C[C@@H]1CC[C@@H](C)N1","O=C(O)c1ccc(Br)cc1","OB(O)c1ccc(O)cc1"]}]}

route_text: {"target_smiles":"CCCCn1ccc(N2CCC(c3ccccc3)CC2)c(Cl)c1=O","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标分子1-丁基-3-氯-4-(4-苯基哌啶-1-基)吡啶-2(1H)-酮，采用汇聚式策略进行逆合成设计。首先在核心吡啶酮的C4位切断C-N键，将其拆分为4位卤素修饰的吡啶酮片段（1-丁基-4-溴-3-氯吡啶-2(1H)-酮）与4-苯基哌啶片段，关键反应设定为后期的Buchwald-Hartwig胺化偶联。该切断极大地简化了母核结构，避免了含叔胺哌啶片段在早期剧烈反应中的潜在副反应。吡啶酮片段的合成关键在于区域与化学选择性：以商业可得的4-溴吡啶-2(1H)-酮为起始原料，利用吡啶酮C3位固有的富电子特性，采用N-氯代丁二酰亚胺进行区域选择性亲电氯化引入C3位氯原子，随后在碱性条件下进行N-烷基化引入正丁基。另一侧的4-苯基哌啶片段则通过4-苯基吡啶的高效催化加氢还原制备，而4-苯基吡啶可由简单的4-溴吡啶与苯硼酸经Suzuki-Miyaura偶联获得。全路线原料廉价易得，步骤经济且可靠性高。","key_disconnection_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":5,"strategy":"基于C-N偶联构建4位取代吡啶酮","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CCCCn1ccc(N2CCC(c3ccccc3)CC2)c(Cl)c1=O","precursors":["CCCCn1ccc(Br)c(Cl)c1=O","c1ccc(C2CCNCC2)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination"},{"step_id":2,"product":"CCCCn1ccc(Br)c(Cl)c1=O","precursors":["O=c1[nH]ccc(Br)c1Cl","CCCCBr"],"reaction_class":"Alkylation"},{"step_id":3,"product":"O=c1[nH]ccc(Br)c1Cl","precursors":["O=c1cc(Br)cc[nH]1","O=C1CCC(=O)N1Cl"],"reaction_class":"Halogenation"},{"step_id":4,"product":"c1ccc(C2CCNCC2)cc1","precursors":["c1ccc(-c2ccncc2)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Reduction"},{"step_id":5,"product":"c1ccc(-c2ccncc2)cc1","precursors":["Brc1ccncc1","OB(O)c1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki coupling"}],"starting_materials":["Brc1ccncc1","CCCCBr","O=C1CCC(=O)N1Cl","O=c1cc(Br)cc[nH]1","OB(O)c1ccccc1"]}]}
